Long term sites (How and Tum) - both 13 years
- Are Droughts and extreme VPD events becoming more unpredictable?


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mgcv)
library(lubridate)

long_term_sites <- c("How", "Tum")

#Define extreme years per site
#drought event - bottom 20th percentile annual precip
#extreme VPD - top 20th percentile annual mean VPD

extreme_years <- map_dfr(long_term_sites, function(site) {
  df <- sites_daily[[site]] %>%
    mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      precip_annual = sum(Precip, na.rm = TRUE), 
      vpd_annual = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      site = site, 
      drought_year = precip_annual < quantile(precip_annual, 0.2, na.rm = TRUE),
      extreme_vpd = vpd_annual > quantile(vpd_annual, 0.8, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
})

print(extreme_years)

```
